notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking any other nontoken creature you control.
The nontoken creature enters the battlefield, triggering Blessed Sanctuary, creating two 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Unicorn tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
